focus.description: Coarse mono blocks resolve into fine colour detail across the clip

dissolve.description: The reverse of focus: fine colour breaks down into coarse mono (good for the last clip)

canopy.description: Dense colour detail, the full 70-step character ramp

moss.description: Green-tinted, partly coloured, dark forest floor

paper.description: Ink on paper (inverted: dark areas get dense characters)
